source_semantics: Entity or session that can be named/recognized as principal in policy evaluation
important_relations_or_lifecycle: principal appears in policy; may be user role role-session service federated user/account
semantic_risk: AWS Principal syntax spans entities and sessions; not a rigid entity kind

source_semantics: AWS-account-local identity with long-term credentials and permissions
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has credentials/policies/groups; can assume role
semantic_risk: Not IdentitySubject/person

source_semantics: IAM identity intended to be assumed by trusted principals; has permissions and trust policy
important_relations_or_lifecycle: trusted principal assumes role; creates role session; session gets temporary credentials
cm4di_target: C1016 PermissionBundle; C0030 Delegation; C0029 AccessGrant; C1015 Session
semantic_risk: Not UFO Role and not simply PermissionBundle; assumption semantics are relational/temporal

source_semantics: Policy specifying who may assume role
important_relations_or_lifecycle: names trusted principal; constrains AssumeRole
semantic_risk: Not generic TrustAssessment or TrustFramework

source_semantics: Policy attached to IAM identity defining allowed/denied actions/resources
important_relations_or_lifecycle: attached to user/group/role; contributes to effective permission
semantic_risk: Policy statements are not identical to Permission instances

source_semantics: Policy attached to resource that names principals and permissions
important_relations_or_lifecycle: resource grants/denies principal actions
semantic_risk: Authorization ownership differs from identity-based policy

source_semantics: Policy passed when creating role/federated session that restricts resulting permissions
important_relations_or_lifecycle: intersects with role/user policies; cannot grant beyond base role permission
semantic_risk: Constraint semantics may require SHACL/rule/evaluation layer rather than ontology class

source_semantics: Managed policy setting maximum permissions for user/role
important_relations_or_lifecycle: effective permissions are intersection with identity policy and other constraints
semantic_risk: Boundary is not an AccessGrant; it constrains grants/policies

source_semantics: Principal created when role is assumed and session credentials are used
important_relations_or_lifecycle: derived from role assumption; has session name; temporary credentials; constrained permissions
semantic_risk: Role session principal is not same individual as IAM Role entity/configuration

source_semantics: Short-lived credentials returned by STS role/federation operations
important_relations_or_lifecycle: issued to session; expire; can be scope-limited
semantic_risk: May be used for human federation too; concept ownership might remain workload profile but mapping is cross-profile

source_semantics: Operation by which trusted principal assumes role and obtains temporary credentials
important_relations_or_lifecycle: requires trust/authorization; creates role session and credentials
semantic_risk: Not exactly OAuth token exchange; event deserves cross-system normalization

source_semantics: IAM Identity Center template containing one or more IAM policies and access settings
important_relations_or_lifecycle: assigned to user/group on account; materializes managed IAM role in target account
semantic_risk: Permission set is not actual account assignment and not application permission

source_semantics: Assignment of user/group plus permission set to AWS account
important_relations_or_lifecycle: creates access entitlement; causes IAM Identity Center-managed role provisioning
semantic_risk: Assignment differs from permission set and generated IAM role

source_semantics: Configured source where IAM Identity Center users/groups are managed
important_relations_or_lifecycle: one source per organization; can be Identity Center directory AD or external IdP
semantic_risk: External IdP may also play federation role; source vs IdP semantics differ

source_semantics: AWS-managed store for users/groups
important_relations_or_lifecycle: stores users/groups; supports direct creation; automatic provisioning
semantic_risk: Store is not IdentitySubject or identity source authority in all scenarios

source_semantics: Synchronizes external IdP users/groups into IAM Identity Center
important_relations_or_lifecycle: create/update/deprovision target identities
semantic_risk: Provisioning is not SAML federation

source_semantics: Group used for assigning access to accounts/applications
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains users; assigned permission sets/app access
semantic_risk: Not social/organizational group by default

source_semantics: User membership determines inherited access assignments
important_relations_or_lifecycle: add/remove member changes access
semantic_risk: Membership may trigger grants but is not itself Permission

source_semantics: Brokers social/OIDC/SAML/user-pool identity tokens to AWS credentials
important_relations_or_lifecycle: accepts external token; maps/chooses IAM role; calls STS; returns temporary credentials
semantic_risk: Identity pool identifier is not human identity and role selection is policy mapping

source_semantics: Chooses IAM role based on token claims or default authentication status
important_relations_or_lifecycle: claim/context selects role before temporary credential issue
semantic_risk: Do not model claim-to-role rule as identity relation

source_semantics: IAM role linked to AWS service with service-managed trust semantics
important_relations_or_lifecycle: service assumes role; lifecycle constrained by service
semantic_risk: Provider-specific managed role pattern; not generic class yet

source_semantics: Cloud account boundary in which IAM identities/resources/policies exist
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains resources/roles/users; part of organization; target of account assignment
semantic_risk: AWS Account is both administrative and resource boundary; not IdentityContext
